exp_image — 2D arithmetic op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "exp_image", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: exp_image (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Maps [0,1] to [0,1] with the exponential mapping `(exp(x) - 1) / (e - 1) (normalized so that x=1 gives exactly 1). This is a contrast enhancement that compresses low tones and emphasizes the highlights, a curve running opposite to log_image. Stands in for HALCON's exp_image` (Calculate the exponentiation of an image.).
